request.message: Which rivers drain the western side of the primary watershed in the area around Holmfirth and Glossop?

response.answer: On the western side of the primary watershed, the drainage is to the Mersey by the rivers Tame and Etherow [E1].

evidences.doc_title: The Geology of the Country Around Holmfirth and Glossop (excerpt)
evidences.text:
On the western side of this line the drainage is to the Mersey
by the rivers Tame and Etherow; the basin of the latter forms a
salient projecting some seven miles east of the general run of
the North Sea—Irish Sea divide (see map, Fig. 1).
